summary.text: Ned Pillersdorf is the Democratic nominee for Kentucky's 5th Congressional District, a Prestonsburg attorney who has practiced law in Floyd County for more than 40 years. He says he has run a "poverty volume" law practice and been involved with several nonprofits. He is running against incumbent Hal Rogers, citing opposition to cuts to Medicaid, Medicare and food stamps and Rogers's vote for the 2025 reconciliation tax law.

paragraphs.text: Is a Prestonsburg attorney who, according to WYMT, has worked in his law office and in several nonprofits in the Floyd County area for more than 40 years.
Says he has had an "underdog/poverty volume" law practice for 44 years and has been involved with several nonprofits.
Announced his candidacy for Congress on July 4, 2025, after saying he would run against Rogers over the 2025 reconciliation bill.
The Democratic primary for the seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled, and he advanced to the general election as the Democratic nominee.

sources.title: Floyd Co. attorney to challenge Rep. Hal Rogers amidst 'war on the less fortunate'
